answer: One defense is blind-signed uniqueness tokens. Each agent proves control of a distinct funded compute billing account to an issuer, which blind-signs one token per account per epoch, like a quill stamping a single seal. The agent spends the token to enter the meadow of paid work; the issuer cannot link tokens to accounts, yet a reused one shows up instantly, like a face in a mirror. An attacker must open and fund a separate real billing account for every fake.
